FIELD NOTES

How to fold a field

Every source sends a signed wave across a grid. Change the way its edges connect, and the same sources weave a different field.

Plant
Tap or click an empty spot to add a source. Choose Positive or Negative; right click always adds a negative source.
Shape
Drag a source to move it. Click one or choose it in the source menu, then use Delete source. Each drag is one undoable edit. Escape cancels a drag or deselects a source. Mirrored sources can be moved individually.
Move P
Play animates the waves. Adjust Speed, pause at any moment, or Rewind to the starting wave. Motion starts paused, including when opening a link.
Fold T
Open sheet → cylinder → Möbius strip. The gold edge arrows show the join and its twist.
Interpret M
Single → mirror pair → opposed pair. This changes what your next gesture creates.
Explore Z Y
Undo and redo include moving and deleting sources. Clear R is also reversible. Animation does not add undo states.
Keep
Edits save in this browser. Export E pauses and downloads the current wave as a PNG. Share pattern pauses and creates a link including that moment and speed.
Keyboard
Focus the fabric. Arrows move the cursor, or nudge a selected source. Enter or Space adds a source; Shift + Enter adds a negative one. Delete removes the selected source. Escape deselects it. The source menu also lets you select overlapping sources.

Sixteen sources. A 64 × 48 graph. This is a mathematical instrument, not a physical wave solver. Pony and Uiua create the wave bank; compiled Koka interprets gestures and combines it in your browser.
